Range.description: An estimate with its uncertainty. `low <= mid <= high`.
Range.title: Range

description:
One row of world-model output for the farm planner (handoff 2b): yearly physical summaries
for one grid point, rotation, weather window and plan year. Each `Range` is the spread across
ensemble members (low/mid/high = P10/P50/P90) for one weather window, not across weather
windows. Null = not predicted; the planner drops a rotation whose scores need it. Scores are
not part of this row: the planner owns normalisation, weights and rules. `crop` is the main
crop of this plan year.

grid_point_id.description: '{lat:.5f}_{lon:.5f}' of the centre of the 0.0025° (about 250 m) grid cell
grid_point_id.title: Grid Point Id

weather_start_season.description: scenario id: first harvest season of the weather window, e.g. 1987
weather_start_season.title: Weather Start Season

season.description: harvest year of the weather used: start + plan_year - 1
season.title: Season

yield_rel.description: yield relative to the crop's local normal (1.0 = normal)

ndvi_offseason.description: mean NDVI outside the crop's season (soil cover)

ndvi_monthly.description: monthly NDVI, January to December of the harvest year, ensemble P50; the planner's soil-water balance reads it
ndvi_monthly.title: Ndvi Monthly

rootzone_sm_critical.description: root-zone soil moisture in the crop's critical months; the planner does not read it (it computes soil water from ndvi_monthly and the weather); may be null

et_season_mm.description: evapotranspiration over the crop's season; the planner does not read it; may be null

title: RotationOutcome
